Ana M: Morning — quick async pulse (what I did / blockers / today / asks)

Ana M: What I did: merged batcher perf tweaks (PR #3124), updated docs for routing policies, ran eval suite on staging.
Ana M: Blockers: integ tests failing intermittently on kv-cache warmup on p4 nodes, stack trace below. Need infra or eng-runtime eyes.
Ana M: Today: iterate on batcher, prep canary for dedicated pool, follow up on quant config.
Ana M: Asks: @Mike T can you review PR #3126 (quant-config) when you get a sec? @Jordan (eng) can you try to repro the integ flake? @Lee can you check p4 node driver mismatch possibility? Thanks :pray:

Mike T: On it — will review PR #3126 this afternoon, fyi might leave an inline perf note. :+1:

Jordan (eng): I'll try repro now. Any quick repro steps?

Ana M: repro: run `pytest tests/integration/test_kv_warmup.py::test_warmup --maxfail=1 -q` on a p4 instance with model=redwood-7b-q4. Fail shows `RuntimeError: KV cache missing for prefix` in logs.

Jordan (eng): got it, thanks. I can repro locally with a sim dataset, will post minimal repro in thread.

Lee: I'll spin up a p4 repro on infra and check driver versions / docker runtime. Suspect CUDA driver mismatch because we saw a similar error last quarter.

DeployBot: Canary deploy for "dedicated-pool/v2" scheduled at 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z. Trigger: PR #3130.

Sara P: No blockers for my side — wrapped up model onboarding docs and finished eval dashboards. Heads-up: OOO tomorrow morning, but reachable for urgent pings. :sun_with_face:

Ana M: If anyone finds a quick fix for the integ flake, drop a tiny PR and tag me. Otherwise I'll gate the canary until we rule out the driver issue.

Mike T: Will ping when review done. If Jordan needs a quick pair debug, ping me and I'll join.

Jordan (eng): Posted minimal repro gist: https://internal.gists/abc123 — includes docker commands and failing log snippet.

Lee: Found p4s with mixed driver versions; opening infra ticket and will sync with eng-runtime in #eng-runtime.

Ana M: Awesome — thanks team. I'll update the canary plan once infra confirms.
